test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The Lal Chowk is a large open square surrounded by mansions of the __wealthiest__ classes than educated ones.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. wealthier.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence compares two groups – "the wealthiest classes" and "educated ones." In such a comparison, the correct form of the adjective must indicate a proper degree of comparison.
